definitionName: CF-1 fuzz/property census (A-16): the closed subject set, the per-suite floors and the recorded case total
note: The ledger entry carried forward from nightwatch-continuous-deep-hardening-v1 task 3.2 reads 'Fuzz/property >=20 cases PASS'. It was recorded once at 12/12 fuzz cases in fuzzProperty.test.ts — below its own threshold — and never re-measured, so the campaign had no honest answer to 'is CF-1 met?'. This declaration is the re-measurement: the closed subject set, what each suite owes, and the total measured on the recorded date. The ratchet only turns one way — REMOVING a case fails the census, adding one does not — and the judgement is pure in src/core/validation/cf1FuzzProperty.ts, driven by tests/unit/cf1FuzzPropertyCensus.test.ts which recounts the declared suites.

subjects.subject: Canonical serializer and prefixed-digest property suite: permutation stability at every nesting depth, idempotence, array order and multiplicity, digest shape, malformed/circular rejection without value echo, unicode and look-alike keys, numeric edge values, prefix-injection resistance, and a deterministic generated corpus.
subjects.recordedNote: Recorded at 12 cases under nightwatch-continuous-deep-hardening-v1; seven real property cases were added under A-16 (M10 11.3) so the suite alone meets the CF-1 entry threshold.

subjects.subject: Frontier contract fuzz: review binding and lifecycle refusal paths, relationship and recurrence classification, provenance confidence caps and the C-12 rehearsal boundary, each asserting a sanitized failure code with no input value echoed.
AH-1 seeded property tests (deterministic mulberry32 streams, recorded seeds) over the Alphaus handoff projection and the C-12 readiness evaluator, 64 generated cases per seed.
